findings.problem: The create form is said to fetch verified numbers from GET /api/numbers but the response shape is not pinned. The live route (src/app/api/numbers/route.ts) returns a bare WhatsAppNumber[] (accessToken stripped), not an envelope like { numbers: [...] }.
findings.fix: Add to §6.4: 'GET /api/numbers returns a bare WhatsAppNumber[] (accessToken stripped); filter client-side on verificationStatus === "verified".'

findings.problem: ApiKey adds whatsappNumber/apiKeys relations to WhatsAppNumber, which already has unnamed Template.whatsappNumber and Message.whatsappNumber relations. The design does not state the new relation is unnamed (default inference), so an implementer might add a spurious @relation("name").
findings.fix: In §1.1 note: 'both new relations are unnamed (default inference), matching the existing unnamed User/WhatsAppNumber relations; no @relation("name") is required.'

findings.problem: The ?status allow-list hardcodes draft|pending|submitted|approved|rejected, duplicating the Template.status comment in schema.prisma. The two can drift silently if a status is added.
findings.fix: Add a comment in §5.3: 'KNOWN mirrors the Template.status comment in schema.prisma; keep in sync if the schema adds a status.'
